name: Oohara Misato
source:
A serious female teacher. Her motto is to interact with students with dignity... which tends to make them keep their distance.

She had a boyfriend during her student days, but for the past few years, she's been single and living an celibate life.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698875&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
